about_the_game:
🏆 Start Your Wrap House Journey – For Free!

Wrap House Simulator🌯 Prologue is a free standalone introduction to the full game, letting you experience the fast-paced world of running a wrap shop. Start in a small kitchen, take customer orders, and perfect the art of making the best wraps. Whether you play solo or team up with friends in multiplayer, your goal is to serve customers quickly and efficiently while keeping your shop running smoothly. 

🔪Chop, Grill, and Wrap Under Pressure!

Every second counts in the kitchen. Slice fresh ingredients, grill meats to perfection, and wrap orders with precision to satisfy hungry customers. The Prologue features a limited selection of ingredients and recipes, challenging you to manage time and resources effectively. As you gain experience, you’ll improve your speed and efficiency in handling multiple orders at once. 

🎉 Team Up and Work Together!

Team up with friends in co-op multiplayer to keep the kitchen running smoothly. Assign tasks, manage stations, and communicate efficiently to serve customers as fast as possible. Success depends on teamwork, and as the orders pile up, coordination becomes essential to keep everything under control. 

🎨 Design Your Dream Wrap House, One Wrap at a Time!

While full-scale customization will be available in the main game, this Prologue offers a first taste of how you can personalize your wrap house with authentic & modern decors, upgrades, and flashy interiors.

What’s Included in the Prologue?

This version offers a focused experience on the core mechanics of wrap-making and shop management. The Prologue features:

  • Single-player and cooperative multiplayer gameplay to run the kitchen together.

  • A limited selection of ingredients and recipes to master the fundamentals.

  • Time-based challenges where quick service earns higher rewards.

  • Basic customization options to personalize your space.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit or newer
  • Processor: i7 4770 / RYZEN 5 1200X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti 4GB or equivalent
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: Welcome to Wrap House Simulator🌯 Prologue! Run your own wrap shop, chop, grill, and serve in this cooking adventure. Customize your shop, master the grill, and survive the rush solo or co-op with up to 4 players. Keep up with orders, satisfy customers, and build your dream restaurant!
